authorities: Phase C final PRISMA flow report, count CSV, and alias crosswalk
Phase E TQAF summary, dimension audit, normalization crosswalk, and scoring code
Phase F final synthesis JSON and S1-S7 CSV files
Related-synthesis source audit and context bibliography for positioning only
content_authority_exclusion: The 76 COMST papers were used only as language and architecture guidance, never as scientific evidence for manuscript counts, mechanisms, or findings.

findings.summary: The abstract reduced the multilabel integration taxonomy to three patterns and omitted canonical coupling locations.
findings.correction: Represented the seven canonical locations without implying an exclusive or hierarchical taxonomy.

findings.summary: Several statements described observational synthesis as causal chains or causal mechanisms.
findings.correction: Recast them as reported or coded coupling mechanisms, associated relationships, and bounded survey inferences.

findings.summary: Integration-ladder and stronger/weaker/tighter language contradicted the non-hierarchical multilabel taxonomy.
findings.correction: Replaced hierarchy with location, purpose, and explicit shared-element descriptions.

findings.summary: Several platform statements could be read as universal prevalence, dominance, or mechanism claims.
findings.correction: Bounded statements to the reviewed evidence and replaced prevalence with within-corpus coverage.

findings.summary: Reviewer-boundary wording obscured investigator conduct and AI assistance.
findings.correction: Stated investigator supervision, recorded governance, bounded AI-supported adjudication, retained provenance, and absence of independent duplicate review.

findings.summary: Discussion contained no thematic comparison with prior syntheses.
findings.correction: Added architecture-, medium-, model-, and deployment-centered comparisons with eight contextual citation-key uses.

findings.summary: Artifact reusability and breadth of joint operation were overstated relative to source-reported availability and study-specific validation.
findings.correction: Restricted artifact language to reported open status and joint evidence to study-specific settings.

findings.summary: Some conclusions and roadmap prescriptions were not explicitly identified as survey inference.
findings.correction: Added framework-, synthesis-, evidence-, and corpus-level boundaries.

findings.summary: The opening technical examples had incomplete citation fit for turbulence-aware links.
findings.correction: Matched fiber sensing, visible-light positioning, and turbulence-aware links to direct primary examples.

findings.summary: The Discussion and Conclusion openings repeated the same inference with high lexical overlap.
findings.correction: Rebuilt the conclusion around separate integration-location and comparability decisions; no cross-file Jaccard hit remains at 0.30.

findings.summary: Several transitions blurred review-specific rule outputs with general scientific quality.
findings.correction: Used recorded-evidence, review-specific-rule, and bounded interpretation language.

residual_limitations: Item 17 is handled by a separate audit line.
The audit reconciles manuscript claims to locked canonical artifacts; it is not a fresh full-text extraction of all 206 PDFs.
No LaTeX compilation was performed by instruction.
Planned figures, tables, and supplements were not materialized in this task.
